meta.pack_name: Viraldy Domain, Creative and Workflow Research Pack
non_claims: No assumption that popularity causes sales

evidence_scale.5: Official platform/regulator/government rule or current operational documentation; strongest source for a hard rule.
evidence_scale.4: Official guidance, established provider documentation, or primary research/preprint; strong but context may limit transfer.
evidence_scale.3: Established product documentation, vendor first-party report, conference/expert interview; useful best practice or directional evidence.
evidence_scale.2: Seller/creator community anecdote; pain evidence only, never prevalence or causality.
evidence_scale.1: Unverified opinion; excluded from deterministic rules.

internal_alignment.principle: Decision system spanning creative research, product adaptation, UGC quality gate, creator/sample, rights/Spark, performance and next action.
Manual-first/API-later architecture; structured objects, stable IDs, provenance and outcome graph.
CreativeDNA is observed asset truth; PatternKit is reusable knowledge; ViralKit is product/campaign-specific compiled hypothesis; models extract/match/score rather than store knowledge.
Every feature follows input → evidence → diagnosis → action → outcome; P0 creative loop before integrations.
Product-grounded, evidence-grounded, decision-grounded and learning-grounded outputs; unknowns must not be invented.
Creative intelligence and element-level analysis patterns adapted to Viraldy niche.
AI-assisted creative analytics, iteration and domain adaptation research.
Research-to-brief workflow, swipe/reference memory and creative operations.
Generation/testing workflow and adaptation into product-aware creative decisions.
